entries.title: Surviving Mars
entries.definitive_edition: Surviving Mars: Relaunched on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC Relaunched release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Surviving Mars: Relaunched on Windows PC is the best current route because it remasters the original, includes all prior DLC, adds the new political system, and keeps the strongest capture/settings path. PS5 and Xbox Series X/S Relaunched are strong console routes, but they do not add sourced exclusive content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Play Surviving Mars: Relaunched on Windows PC through Steam or Epic for the remastered all-DLC route. Use the original 2018 version only if you specifically need macOS/Linux or last-generation console access.

entries.remaster_caveats: Relaunched is the remastered/current version of Surviving Mars, not a sequel. The 2018 macOS/Linux/last-gen releases remain separate access routes for the original version.

entries.title: Surviving the Aftermath
entries.definitive_edition: Surviving the Aftermath on Windows PC with DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the original Early Access and full-release route, with the complete DLC path and best capture/settings flexibility. PS4, Xbox One, and Switch are valid console routes, but they add no sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Steam, Epic, GOG, or Paradox and add New Alliances, Shattered Hope, and Rebirth for the full DLC route.

entries.remaster_caveats: New Alliances, Shattered Hope, and Rebirth are DLC packs, not separate game entries.

entries.title: Surviving the Abyss
entries.definitive_edition: Surviving the Abyss on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Surviving the Abyss is a Windows PC release, and the 1.0 Steam version is the only sourced complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Steam; use the 1.0 or later branch rather than the old Early Access build.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 1.0 release is the full release after Early Access, not a remaster or sequel.
